video_title: Luka Doncic has the most PRESSURE out of ANY superstar in the NBA 👀

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic faces immense pressure to win a championship now
quotes.excerpt: In order to be put on that pedestal, you got to win.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Does Luka Doncic have the most pressure in the NBA as a superstar to win now after what happened this year? Let me break it down for you. Jalen Brunson was your second guy. He wasn't really thought about until the playoffs, he earned his pay. Then goes to the Knicks, he wins a championship before you. Karl-Anthony Towns wins a championship. If you have those two things happen, you're on the same team as this guy. Luka has a chance to be up there with the greats. So with that being said, if you're going to sit here and you got your top five players in the league, you got Steph Curry, you got Jalen Brunson, you got Giannis Antetokounmpo, you got Nikola Jokic, those are all chips right there. All of those guys got chips right there.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: There is some pressure because the Lakers want to win. There is some pressure because in order to be put on that pedestal, you got to win. And that's what you said about Victor Wembanyama, like he has to win. I'm not crowning him, bro, until he wins. When he wins, then cool. It's your league, young fella, you got it.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic is under more pressure than any other superstar
quotes.excerpt: He is under the most pressure of anybody.
quotes.quote: He is under the most pressure of anybody. We all say that Luka can be considered one of the greatest, one of the greats, right? But in order to be put on that pedestal, you got to win. And that's what you said about Victor Wembanyama, like he has to win. I'm not crowning him, bro, until he wins. When he wins, then cool. It's your league, young fella, you got it.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic will be viewed differently if he doesn't win
quotes.excerpt: If he don't win, you're going to start seeing Luka in a different light.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: If he don't win, you're going to start seeing Luka in a different light. In a different light and people are going to start taking him out of that top five.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: They going to take him out of that top five because he's not winning.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Durant's legacy is already cemented as a great hooper
quotes.excerpt: His legacy already cemented just off what he's done as a hooper.
quotes.quote: I don't care if Kevin Durant don't win by himself. His legacy already cemented just off what he's done as a hooper. Just a hooper. Like forget, forget winning, forget championships, any of that. What he's done as a hooper, as a seven-foot guard, is cementing him Hall of Famer as a basketball player.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Raymond Felton's list of players needing a big year
quotes.excerpt: To me, Booker, Wembanyama, Ja, Ant.
quotes.quote: To me, Booker, Wembanyama, Ja, Ant. Four guys. It's a big year for them. You have to do something, or else you're going to be labeled. They're at that point where like, all right, is Wembanyama going to be the face of the league? Is Wembanyama going to be that dude, or he's just going to be a tall dude that's always going to have a good year?

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' future with the Lakers remains uncertain
quotes.excerpt: LeBron is off. LeBron is gone.
quotes.quote: LeBron is off. LeBron is gone. We know that. No, we don't know. We don't know. He's gone. They said they're not giving you the max, bro. They're not giving LeBron the max.
